gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-kadwa: Red Hat Display draws every curve with a marker-like line, bold and modern, with daylight inside each bowl. Kadwa follows with a classic serif that stands taller in the lowercase, giving the headline a sturdier, more editorial partner.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, a classic serif whose lowercase stands tall like cast iron capitals. Red Hat Display is best at blunt, unshaded strokes that guide the eye fast, while the body is best at mild stress in the o and e.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-montagu-slab:
Red Hat Display is contemporary, bold and drawn like a marker.

Montagu Slab carries long reading comfortably, its sturdy downstrokes and slender turns giving a sizable lowercase an open channel in the e.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noticia-text: Red Hat Display is best at bold, marker-like lines with visible daylight inside every curve. Noticia Text is best at literary calm, its big entrance strokes and tall lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-serif-hen: A marker-like line that never swells or thins gives Red Hat Display its contemporary punch. And Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif with subtle stroke modulation and small letters nearly capital height, adds a traditional, refined voice beneath it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ovo:
Ovo is a text serif with a tall middle band and authority.

Red Hat Display above it is bolder and more contemporary, its marker-like line standing against the gentle thick-and-thin of the body.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-piazzolla:
Refined and authoritative, Piazzolla is a text serif.

Red Hat Display above it draws a wire-like, constant line with daylight in every curve, while the body's lowercase rises nearly to capital height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-pridi:
Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe define Red Hat Display.

Pridi sits beneath as a refined text serif, its small letters standing proud and almost capital-sized, with generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-scope-one: Refined and traditional, Scope One has stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height. Under Red Hat Display, whose stroke has no swell or thin spots, it makes a classic serif body that feels grounded against a bold heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px:
Bold marker lines, then bookish warmth.

Red Hat Display holds one pen width throughout, while Slabo 13px, a serif with large open counters and clear openings in rounded letters, brings a dignified weight below it.
